posts.text: Any one tracking this stock? It has appreciated significantly from 52 week low of 58 level. But few things that came to my notice are shared below for comments from fellow members. It has a capacity of 7200 MTPA in H- Acid in India(highest as that of Kiri). But the appreciation in H- Acid price has not rubbed off on its result. It’s Q1 profit has come down from Q4 of 2026, where as others having small capacity of H-acid has shown much better result. Being back ward integrated with highest capacity it should have shown better result. So present market appears to be elevated. I have also observe…
